scientific_integrity: A direct orbit-complex and perfect-matching proof supports the stated PL fixed-space theorem; computation checks examples only.
scientific_limitations: Only individual dihedral element fixed loci of the ordinary three-robust cycle complex; no subgroup intersections, arbitrary robust parameters or equivariant homotopy equivalence. Finite verification is not proof of infinite range. Independent validation not performed.
title: Dihedral geometric fixed circles in cycle three-robust clique complexes
